name: Guardian Pipeline G3 Expansion
researcher_notes: Guardian Pipeline LLC filed a FERC certificate application in docket CP26-548-000 on July 1, 2026. It asks to build 68.3 miles of new 36 inch loop in two pieces, the Joliet Loop and the Sycamore Loop, in Kendall, DeKalb and McHenry counties, Illinois. It also adds compressors in Will County, Illinois, a new compressor station in Dodge County, Wisconsin, and a new meter station in Fond du Lac County, Wisconsin. Capacity is about 536,903 Dth per day of firm service. Cost is about 890 million USD. Target in service is November 2028 and a certificate is requested by June 2027. The operator project page and the FERC notice in the Federal Register agree. They are two different publishers, but the operator page is the applicant's own. Existing GEM row P0195 is the operating main line, so this is a separate expansion row under the same pipeline name. The sheet lists P0195 owner as ONEOK, but DT Midstream says it bought Guardian on December 31, 2024. That owner on P0195 should be checked. Owner spelling follows the gazetteer hit for DT Midstream Inc. Proposal year 2025 is from the two binding open seasons held in 2025 per the operator page. Route: not researched. Two loop segments are not yet mapped, so RouteType and RouteAccuracy are left blank for a human to do from FERC filings. Start and end are the loop areas near the Joliet and Sycamore compressor stations, which should be checked against the FERC resource reports.
